Yes No Requesting a Fee Waiver Complete the most current version of Form I-912, Request for Fee Waiver, or write and sign a letter asking for a fee waiver and provide all the necessary information and supporting evidence to establish your eligibility. You must clearly demonstrate that you are unable to pay the filing fees. Please follow all instructions, complete all necessary sections of Form I-912, or your letter, and submit proper documentation to avoid common rejection reasons. (See Common reasons why we reject fee waiver requests). _note: BRANCH of 02-able-to-pay.json with the radio set to 'No'. Answering No reveals the Form I-912 fee-waiver upload INLINE on the same page (no navigation) and adds 'Upload Form I-912' to the sidebar. next-btn goes DISABLED until the I-912 (or signed fee-waiver letter) is uploaded. Upload control text is item-specific here - 'Choose or drop file here to upload a I-912 form' - unlike the generic 'Choose or drop file here to upload' on the I-765. Accept list: jpeg/jpg/tif/tiff/pdf, multiple=true. Draft was returned to 'Yes' after this capture.
